basis: Reconstructed all pre-2026 parent decisions against actual fills/NAV with maximum target error 1.6653345369377348e-16, without a new portfolio replay. Union/common-five/joint-leader-removal contain 16/12/13 individual-unbroken full exits solely at zero portfolio risk capacity. After actual disposal, 14/16/10 symbol-closes retain the old stop, have three current healthy observations, recovered risk authority, a vacant slot, actual cash and no current protective reduction; 7/13/3 have no parent purchase, across 4/6/3 suspended campaigns. These are state witnesses, not guaranteed funded orders or causal profits. Both favorable and adverse holding/exit observations are retained. An earlier claim that August 2023 stale health permission caused an entry was disproved by the revocable replay and is not a premise here.
hypothesis: Separate temporary portfolio-wide suspension of an actually held, individually intact campaign from termination of that campaign's investment thesis. Execute every protective liquidation first. Once risk authority and that symbol's present health recover, permit bounded restoration from remaining actual cash rather than require that previously held campaign to be a wholly new breakout. This is not generic earlier reentry after a price stop or a second ranked replacement book.
capture: After the unchanged parent decision, record actual units and its nondecreasing live stop only for a newly requested full liquidation at zero portfolio risk cap, with price strictly above the live stop, no individual exit, fresh readiness and no pre-existing full-exit obligation. Do not record requested purchases, partial risk cuts, price/stale exits, other symbols or future winners. Never reduce or cancel the parent's exit or economic ceiling.
lifecycle: The suspended quantity is an upper bound equal to previously observed actual units, not a guaranteed claim on cash. Retain the exit-time stop as a minimum admission/protection floor; any later close at or below it, an individual exit or stale observation cancels eligibility, without cancelling sale obligations. Count consecutive fresh, above-existing-fast-SMA, no-individual-exit observations only while actually flat; reset on deterioration or held inventory. Use the existing Config.recovery count. Any observed actual new holding consumes that suspended opportunity and ends only its flat readmission veto; pending/live stops, actual NAV history and protective obligations remain. Blocked or partial liquidation cannot authorize restoration. An unfilled restoration request is not an actual new holding.
allocation: Reuse the observed-admission parent as the single account owner and run it exactly once per close. Do not change its regular entries, rankings, holdings, stops, risk state or existing purchase targets. Only after its full decision, and only with no remaining protected sale, use residual real cash and residual cap/risk authority after reserving ALL parent purchases. Consider still-flat suspended names in unchanged descending current positive score order, with existing two-position, single-name/sector and one-percent fresh-materiality limits. Current readiness, no individual exit, mature current flat health and price above max(old stop,current admission stop,pending stop) are required; the fresh-entry breakout/readmission test is deliberately not reapplied to these bounded restored campaigns. Limit added units to the suspended actual quantity and risk to the original per-new-position share; do not complete beyond that bound. Use at least the retained stop for the pending buy and subsequent actual holding. Current prices, costs, lots, liquidity, delayed fills and T+1 are unchanged. A full book, pending sale, insufficient cash or failed risk test simply rejects restoration. There are no expected-sale proceeds, shadow accounts, synthetic fills or higher leverage.
implementation_boundary: A small outer owner extension only; do not rewrite old owners, reset state, replace an observed owner, monkey-patch feature arrays, amend frozen contracts or import private reference code. Preserve the failed reentry variants and the concurrent source/config/neighborhood/native-reference work. No new numerical parameter, symbol exception, calendar rule, model fit or candidate grid.
selection: Exactly one empty-parameter candidate under the unchanged finite_study pre-2026 three scopes, same-source controls, minimax wealth/drawdown/fill definition, objective and tie-breaks. Do not rerun any completed old study, broad fixed validation or separately claimed neighborhood/native work.
verification: only actual individual-unbroken zero-cap exits create suspension
actual flat health matures on observations, not requested orders
old stop and stale/individual invalidation are binding
current risk/cash/name/sector/position limits and all parent purchases are reserved
restoration never exceeds previously actual units
actual acquisition consumes the opportunity without erasing stops or risk history
no-suspension path equals the original owner
evaluation: Keep all raw selection and five-window evaluation outcomes even after failure. All original economic goals, original pools, actual contributor and sector removals, sizes/subsets, fees/delays, neighbors, risk signal/fill/exposure/false-alarm/recovery behavior, native references and exact-source causal checks remain before production promotion. The existing 555-account fixed validation is evidence for its own source only, not this candidate.
limitations: 2026 is retrospective, not untouched out-of-sample. Adjusted units are not a verified actual-share/corporate-action/tax ledger. No waived gates, universal economic-superiority claim or future-return guarantee. Main and original PR #1 remain unpromoted until the same production candidate satisfies original acceptance.
